{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, confirm that some entries have commas
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Clean the revenue column
if has_commas.sum() > 0:
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Now, filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = data[data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
conversion_rate_loyal = loyal_customers['converted'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate_loyal}")"}
